capabilities.name: Bounded event scheduler
capabilities.summary: Runs event-driven modules with global/per-target pacing, timeouts, deduplication, and optional adaptive workers.

capabilities.name: Dashboard, REST, GraphQL, and streams
capabilities.summary: Provides operator views, scan controls, evidence APIs, event streams, token roles, and mutation audit.

capabilities.name: Host and DNS discovery
capabilities.summary: Performs bounded DNS, CIDR, liveness, IPv6, ARP, virtual-host, and offline evidence discovery.

capabilities.name: Authenticated distributed scanning
capabilities.summary: Provides digest-bound jobs, enrolled Ed25519 agents, replay protection, bounded leases, evidence upload, and centralized reporting.

capabilities.name: HA coordinator failover
capabilities.summary: Provides active/passive coordinator leadership, fenced mutations, standby rejection, and monotonic epoch takeover.

capabilities.name: HTTP, TLS, and API enumeration
capabilities.summary: Provides bounded crawling, technology, directory/API, source-map, screenshot, HTTP/3, and gRPC-reflection enumeration.

capabilities.name: Idle and decoy scanning
capabilities.summary: Third-party and spoofed-traffic runners are not connected to production scans.
required_conditions: separate authorization for every participating host

capabilities.name: Inventory, drift, graphs, and risk
capabilities.summary: Persists history and builds deterministic changes, relationships, prioritization, risk, and exposure-chain evidence.

capabilities.name: Bounded continuous monitoring
capabilities.summary: Runs finite recurring scope-locked scans only through an explicit monitor command.

capabilities.name: Passive intelligence providers
capabilities.summary: Normalizes supported third-party intelligence providers with pacing, quota, version, and credential diagnostics.

capabilities.name: Signed plugin marketplace
capabilities.summary: Provides explicit HTTPS discovery, ratings, versions, Ed25519 verification, atomic installation, and updates.

capabilities.name: OS-level plugin sandbox
capabilities.summary: Provides OS-level process isolation, separate process groups, resource ceilings, and stripped environments for untrusted plugins.

capabilities.name: Lua and gRPC plugin runtimes
capabilities.summary: Provides capability-limited Lua and TLS-required remote gRPC execution; scans do not auto-load plugins.

capabilities.name: Port and service enumeration
capabilities.summary: Collects bounded TCP/UDP state, banners, protocol responses, services, and CPE candidates.

capabilities.name: PostgreSQL operational datastore
capabilities.summary: Core schema and operations exist, but full SQLite behavioral and migration parity is not release-complete.

capabilities.name: Raw TCP techniques
capabilities.summary: Supports explicitly selected raw SYN, ACK, FIN, NULL, XMAS, window, Maimon, and fragmented probes.

capabilities.name: Reports and notifications
capabilities.summary: Generates JSON, Markdown, HTML, PDF, SARIF, CSV, executive, technical, triage, and graph outputs with explicit notifications.
network_effects: optional configured webhook, Slack, SMTP, Neo4j, or loopback Ollama requests

capabilities.name: Target scope enforcement
capabilities.summary: Checks configured and discovered targets against explicit address, CIDR, and domain scope.

capabilities.name: Production secret managers
capabilities.summary: Supports native OS keychains plus configured Vault, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, and GCP adapters without plaintext fallback.

capabilities.name: Specialized protocol enumeration
capabilities.summary: Provides opt-in SMB, LDAP, SNMP, cloud, container, database, SSH, FTP, and SMTP capability checks.

capabilities.name: SQLite operational datastore
capabilities.summary: Provides native migrations, evidence persistence, encrypted sensitive fields, retention, and encrypted backup/restore.

capabilities.name: Credentialed host and directory assessment
capabilities.summary: SSH, WinRM, authenticated AD, Kerberos, LAPS, permission, secret, IMDS, and active DNS runners remain planned.

capabilities.name: Active TLS vulnerability verification
capabilities.summary: Heartbleed, ROBOT, CRIME, and BREACH runners are not connected to scans.

capabilities.name: Active web payload verification
capabilities.summary: SQLi, XSS, SSRF, file inclusion, XXE, SSTI, host-header, request-smuggling, and prototype-pollution runners are not connected.
